desc.zh: 关税的钱由进口商交给海关，最后却不一定是他出。这篇从需求弹性讲起，用可以拖动的模型讲关税负担怎么在买卖双方之间分、国家的账本上谁得谁失、比较优势为什么让双方都得利、贸易逆差为什么等于储蓄减投资，再讲汇率抵消、报复、贸易改道和出口管制，最后整理 2018 年以来关于“谁付了关税”的实证研究，截至 2026 年 11 月。九个可以动手的模型，只讲模型和证据，不替任何一方表态。
desc.en: A tariff is paid to customs by the importer, but that is not who ends up bearing it. Nine hands-on models, from elasticity and tariff incidence to comparative advantage, S − I = CA, exchange-rate offsets, retaliation, trade diversion and export controls, ending with the evidence on who paid the 2018–19 and 2025 US tariffs, as of November 2026. Models and evidence only; no position on any policy.

desc.zh: 关税在买卖价之间打进楔子，买方承担的份额由两边弹性决定，与谁去海关交钱无关。
desc.en: A tariff drives a wedge between buyer and seller prices; the buyer's share depends on the two elasticities, not on who pays customs.

title.zh: 关税福利账本与最优关税
title.en: Tariff welfare and the optimal tariff

desc.zh: 关税让买方受损、本国厂商和政府受益，小国净损失；大国存在最优关税，但好处来自外国更大的损失。
desc.en: Buyers lose, home producers and the treasury gain; a small country loses on net, a large one has an optimal tariff paid for by a larger foreign loss.

en: is a tariff good for a country

title.zh: S − I = CA：逆差是储蓄减投资

desc.zh: 经常账户差额在定义上等于储蓄减投资；不改变储蓄和投资的政策改不了总逆差。
desc.en: The current account equals saving minus investment by definition; a policy that leaves both unchanged cannot change the overall deficit.

en: can tariffs reduce the trade deficit

title.zh: 汇率抵消、贸易改道与报复
title.en: Exchange-rate offset, trade diversion and retaliation

desc.zh: 被征税国货币贬值抵掉部分涨价，进口改从第三国来，双方都征最优关税会陷入囚徒困境。
desc.en: The target's currency offsets part of a tariff, imports divert to third countries, and mutual optimal tariffs are a prisoner's dilemma.

desc.zh: 供应高度集中时限制出口短期冲击大，替代出现后武器变钝；稀土与先进芯片是两个例子。
desc.en: When supply is concentrated an export ban bites hard at first and blunts as substitutes appear; rare earths and advanced chips are the examples.

desc.zh: 用加税和未加税商品的差异估计转嫁率；边境转嫁和零售转嫁是两个不同的数。
desc.en: Pass-through is estimated against untaxed goods (difference-in-differences); border and retail pass-through are different numbers.

zh: 关税转嫁到消费者了吗
en: did tariffs pass through to consumers

desc.zh: 2018–19 年美国关税几乎全部由美国承担；2025 年关税的转嫁估计多在八九成以上，也有研究认为外国吸收近半。
desc.en: The 2018–19 US tariffs fell almost wholly on US buyers; 2025 estimates mostly find 80–94% border pass-through, one finds foreign exporters absorbed nearly half.
